Department of Public Works and Buildings Division of Highways Office of the Regional Transportation Engineer 300 North State Street - Room 907 Chicago, Illinois 60610
Attention: Henry M. Yamanaka, Mobility Studies Engineer
Re: Mobility Studies, Lincoln Highway Improvement Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road, Cook County
Dear Mr. Yamanaka:
TTONI, JR.
At the regular board meeting of Wednesday, January 12, 1972, the Board of Education unamimously accepted the Building Committee's recommendation to accept Scheme A as submitted by the Department of Public Works and Buildings.
This concurs with the City of Chicago Heights decision to also accept Scheme A as submitted by the Department of Public Works and Buildings.
If you have any questions on the above matter, please do not hesitate to contact me immediately.
Yours truly,
Charles n Kelli
Charles N. Rellis Assistant Superintendent
